title: Account for internally developed software and cloud computing arrangements

items.concept: Initial recognition of software-for-sale costs (expense vs capitalize at technological feasibility); subsequent amortization using greater of revenue method vs straight-line (multi-year schedule); period-end amortization JEs; disposal write-off of remaining book value
Number-variant twin: software-for-sale R&D vs capitalization at technological feasibility; multi-year amortization schedule (greater of revenue vs SL); period-end amortization JEs

Internal-use software (preliminary vs application development; training expensed); cloud computing hosting as service contract — capitalize implementation, expense subscription, amortize over hosting term; period-end adjusting JEs; classification/presentation of cloud implementation costs
Classification — expense vs capitalize for software-for-sale, internal-use, and cloud service-contract costs
